ui.chat.draft_target.aria_label.role: accessible name and tooltip of the New chat header's agent/team chip
ui.chat.draft_target.aria_label.tone: plain statement then an imperative, sentence case
ui.chat.draft_target.aria_label.note: Read by screen readers and shown on hover over the chip in a new, not-yet-sent chat's header. States who will answer the conversation once the first message is sent, then says the chip lets the user change it. 'agent' and 'team' are glossary terms.

placeholders.target: the chosen agent's name, a team's display label, or the translated 'Default agent' string. Keep verbatim; never translate an agent or team name.

ui.chat.draft_target.default_agent.role: chip label and first menu row meaning no specific agent or team is chosen
ui.chat.draft_target.default_agent.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.draft_target.default_agent.length: Two words; it sits in the chat header beside the device chip.
ui.chat.draft_target.default_agent.note: Shown in a new chat's header when the user has not picked an agent or team: the conversation will be answered by the app's default agent. Also the menu row that clears a previous pick. 'agent' is a glossary term.

ui.chat.draft_target.menu_heading.role: heading at the top of the agent/team menu opened from a new chat's header
ui.chat.draft_target.menu_heading.tone: short heading, sentence case, no trailing punctuation or colon
ui.chat.draft_target.menu_heading.note: Introduces a list whose rows are 'Default agent', then a section of agents and a section of teams. A question form ('Who should this chat start with') is fine where a dangling preposition reads poorly.
